name: Weather-based discount
description:
# Context The shop grants a 10 percent offer-level discount while it rains or snows in Warsaw, read from the Open-Meteo current-weather API (spec, Goal). Three drivers shape the design: - **First of a family.** Temperature, wind, cloud cover, humidity and UV discounts follow; adding one must take one new field, one new query parameter and one new potential discount (spec, Extension recipe). - **The weather API must never break pricing.** Any failure means "weather unknown", never an exception out of discount calculation (spec, Scope; rule 2). - **It fits the existing discount machinery.** Potential discounts are filtered by `Conditions` and registered in one configuration, as the VIP discount is today (spec, Rules 3 and 4). # Decisions ## D1. Weather is a module of its own, behind a port The new [weather](noesis:module|discounts.weather) module pairs the [Weather](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.Weather) snapshot with its [WeatherProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.WeatherProvider) port, the same way the users module pairs UserStatus with UserStatusProvider. - **Why:** weather is a condition a discount depends on, not part of calculating one; following the existing users pattern keeps one way of feeding outside facts into discounts. - **Trade-off:** one more module for a single value object and port, paid back from the second weather discount on. ## D2. Open-Meteo is an adapter, and its failure means unknown weather [OpenMeteoWeatherProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.openmeteo.OpenMeteoWeatherProvider) sits in a nested [openmeteo](noesis:module|discounts.weather.openmeteo) module and implements the port. [Its getCurrent](noesis:behavior|discounts.weather.openmeteo.OpenMeteoWeatherProvider.getCurrent) turns a network error, a timeout, a non-2xx status or a body it cannot read into "no weather", so [WeatherProvider.getCurrent](noesis:behavior|discounts.weather.WeatherProvider.getCurrent) answers a snapshot or nothing, never an error. - **Why:** spec, rule 2 and acceptance scenario 3. - **The location and the requested parameters are the adapter's configuration**, not inputs of `getCurrent`: every discount is evaluated for the one shop, and a new weather parameter extends the adapter's list and mapping without touching the port. - **Trade-off:** no caching and no retries (spec, out of scope), so every policy resolution makes one HTTP call; the request carries an explicit timeout so a slow API cannot stall it. ## D3. Weather reaches discounts through Conditions [Conditions](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.Conditions) gains an optional weather, and [DiscountPolicyFactory](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountPolicyFactory) gets the port. [DiscountPolicyFactory.get](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountPolicyFactory.get) reads the weather once per resolution and puts it into the conditions; its signature stays as it is. - **Why:** potential discounts already decide from `Conditions` alone (spec, Scope). Reading weather there, once, means every weather discount in one resolution sees the same snapshot (spec, rule 4) and none of them talks to the provider. - **Trade-off:** the weather is read even when no registered discount needs it. ## D4. The precipitation discount is a potential discount granting a percentage [PotentialPrecipitationDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.PotentialPrecipitationDiscount) is applicable exactly while the known precipitation is above 0 mm ([isApplicableFor](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialPrecipitationDiscount.isApplicableFor)); unknown weather is treated as no rain, never as an error. [It grants](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialPrecipitationDiscount.getDiscount) a new [PercentageDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.PercentageDiscount), whose [apply](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PercentageDiscount.apply) records one offer-level discount amount, as the existing fixed discount does. - **Why:** spec, rules 1 and 2. A percentage discount of its own, rather than a weather-specific one, is reusable by every later weather discount. - **Weather discounts stack** with the VIP discount and every other one; exclusivity stays with the existing exclusive-discount wrapper (spec, rule 3). ## D5. One configuration registers every weather discount [DiscountsConfigProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountsConfigProvider) registers the precipitation discount at 10 percent next to the VIP discount in [getDiscountsConfig](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountsConfigProvider.getDiscountsConfig). - **Why:** it is where potential discounts are configured today, and the extension recipe needs one place to add the next weather discount. # How they connect D1 and D2 give a weather snapshot that may be missing; D3 is what lets D4 decide from it without knowing where it came from; D5 makes D4 active and is the one place the family grows. ```mermaid flowchart TB accTitle: How the weather reaches a discount factory["DiscountPolicyFactory.get"] -- "once per resolution" --> port["WeatherProvider.getCurrent"] port -. "implemented by" .-> meteo["OpenMeteoWeatherProvider
failure = unknown"] factory -- "weather or nothing" --> conditions["Conditions"] config["DiscountsConfigProvider"] -- "registers" --> potential["PotentialPrecipitationDiscount"] conditions --> potential potential -- "precipitation > 0" --> percentage["PercentageDiscount 10%"] ``` The next weather discount follows the same path: a field on `Weather`, a parameter in the adapter, a potential discount registered in the configuration. # Left out and open - Other weather discounts: only their extension points are prepared. - Caching and retries of weather responses, and a configurable location (spec, out of scope). - Money arithmetic: a discount amount stays a marker of the applied discount (spec, out of scope).

definition.value: The current weather at the shop's location, as one of the conditions a discount can depend on.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The Open-Meteo weather service as the source of the current weather.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A snapshot of the current weather at the shop's location, from which every weather-based discount reads.
definition.author: agent

added.name: precipitation

description.value: Current precipitation in millimetres as reported by the weather provider (rain or snow). 0 means dry weather.
description.author: agent

added.name: Weather snapshot carries precipitation in millimetres

description.value: The snapshot describes the current weather at the configured location; precipitation is a numeric value in millimetres exactly as reported by the provider, without rounding. Future weather parameters become further fields on this same snapshot so every weather discount reads from one object taken at one moment.
description.author: agent

definition.value: The source of the current weather for discount decisions: it gives a weather snapshot, or says the weather is unknown.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: The weather source backed by the Open-Meteo forecast service.
definition.author: agent

definition.value: A discount of a percentage of the whole offer's value.
definition.author: agent

added.name: percentage

description.value: Discount percentage of the whole offer; 10 for the precipitation discount.
description.author: agent

added.name: Percentage discount is an offer-level discount recorded as a discount amount

description.value: A percentage discount holds a percentage value and, when applied, appends exactly one DiscountAmount referencing itself to the offer-level discounts of the DiscountedOffer, leaving product-level discounts untouched. It follows the same shape as FixedDiscount; no money computation happens in this iteration.
description.author: agent

added.name: Weather discounts stack with other discounts

description.value: A weather-based discount neither excludes any other discount nor is excluded by one; a VIP user in the rain receives both the VIP fixed discount and the precipitation discount. Exclusivity is only introduced if a configurator wraps the discount in the existing ExclusiveOfferLevelDiscount.
description.author: agent

definition.value: A discount a customer can get while it is raining or snowing at the shop's location.
definition.author: agent

added.name: discount

description.value: The discount granted when the precipitation condition holds; configured as 10 percent.
description.author: agent

added.name: weather

description.value: Current weather snapshot, absent when the weather provider could not deliver one (Option<Weather>).
description.author: agent

added.name: weatherProvider

description.value: Port used to read the current weather once per policy resolution.
description.author: agent

definition.value: Tells the current weather at the shop's location, or that it is unknown.
definition.author: agent

description.value: The current weather; absent when it cannot be determined. A failure of the source is never an exception to the caller, only an absent result, which the calculation reads as unknown weather.

definition.value: Tells the current weather at the shop's location as the Open-Meteo forecast service reports it.
definition.author: agent

description.value: The weather whose precipitation is the current.precipitation of the forecast response. Absent on a network error, a timeout, a non-2xx status, or a body that cannot be parsed or lacks current.precipitation; such a failure is not logged in a way that interrupts processing.

added.name: Provider failure means unknown weather

description.value: Any network error, timeout, non-2xx HTTP status or unparsable response body results in an empty result, i.e. weather unknown. The adapter never propagates an exception into discount calculation; missing weather is a normal outcome, not an error.
description.author: agent

added.name: Weather API failure does not break discount calculation

description.value: Covers HTTP 500, a timeout and malformed JSON from the weather API; each must degrade to unknown weather.
description.author: agent

given.value: the weather API responds with HTTP 500, or does not respond within the request timeout, or returns a body that is not valid JSON
given.author: agent

then.value: the result is empty, no exception is thrown, and a subsequent discount calculation completes with no weather discount
then.author: agent

added.name: Open-Meteo response is mapped to a weather snapshot

description.value: Integration test of the adapter against a local HTTP stub standing in for Open-Meteo.
description.author: agent

given.value: a local HTTP stub answering {"current":{"precipitation":0.5}} and the adapter pointed at that stub
given.author: agent

then.value: the result is a Weather with precipitation 0.5
then.author: agent

definition.value: Grants the percentage discount on an offer.
definition.author: agent

added.name: discountedOffer

description.value: The offer to discount; it is not changed.
A new DiscountedOffer with the same products and one more offer-level DiscountAmount for this percentage discount. Applying it twice gives two such entries.

definition.value: Tells whether the weather in the given conditions earns the precipitation discount: it does while it rains or snows.
definition.author: agent

added.name: conditions

description.value: The conditions to judge. The weather is read from them alone, never from the weather provider.

added.name: Precipitation above zero makes the precipitation discount applicable

description.value: The discount is applicable exactly when the conditions carry a known weather snapshot whose precipitation is strictly greater than 0 mm. Precipitation equal to 0 is dry weather and yields no discount. The threshold is a business constant of this discount, not of the weather provider.
description.author: agent

added.name: Unknown weather never grants a weather discount

description.value: When the weather provider could not deliver a snapshot and the conditions carry no weather, every weather-based potential discount reports itself as not applicable. Missing data is treated as no rain, never as an error and never as rain.
description.author: agent

added.name: Rain grants the precipitation discount

description.value: Happy path for a non-VIP user during rain.
description.author: agent

diagram.value:
sequenceDiagram
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>UserStatusProvider: getFor(userId)
  UserStatusProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: UserStatus
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>WeatherProvider: getCurrent()
  WeatherProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: Option<Weather>
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>DiscountsConfigProvider: getDiscountsConfig()
  DiscountsConfigProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: DiscountConfig
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>Conditions: build(userStatus, weather)
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>DiscountConfig: getDiscountsForConditions(conditions)
  DiscountConfig->>PotentialPrecipitationDiscount: isApplicableFor(conditions)
  DiscountConfig-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: List<Discount>
diagram.author: agent
